parrafo_1.es: Joshua Tree Plumbing es un negocio de plomeria residencial con base en Tampa. Las resenas de clientes describen siempre lo mismo: Josh llega, explica el problema en palabras simples y hace la reparacion de forma limpia, ya sea en una remodelacion de cocina, un calentador de agua nuevo o un drenaje dificil.
parrafo_1.en: Joshua Tree Plumbing is a Tampa-based residential plumbing business. Customer reviews describe the same thing again and again: Josh shows up, explains the problem in plain terms and gets the repair done cleanly, whether it's a kitchen remodel, a new water heater or a stubborn drain.

parrafo_2.es: Clientes de Tampa, Brandon y Riverview repiten lo mismo en Google: el trabajo queda bien hecho y el lugar queda limpio al terminar. Esa reputacion se refleja en un rating de 4.8 con 54 resenas.
parrafo_2.en: Clients across Tampa, Brandon and Riverview point to the same two things on Google: the work is done right and the place is left clean when he's finished. That reputation shows in a 4.8 rating from 54 reviews.

texto.es: Cuentanos que pasa, una fuga, un drenaje tapado o un problema con el calentador, y te damos una respuesta clara sobre el tiempo.
texto.en: Tell us what's going on, a leak, a clogged drain or a water heater issue, and we give you a straight answer on timing.

texto.es: Josh revisa el problema en persona antes de tocar nada, para que sepas exactamente que hay que arreglar y por que.
texto.en: Josh checks the issue in person before touching anything, so you know exactly what needs fixing and why.

texto.es: La reparacion se hace con las piezas correctas desde la primera vez, ya sea una valvula, un calentador o una linea de drenaje.
texto.en: The repair gets done with the right parts the first time, whether it's a valve, a water heater or a drain line.

texto.es: Antes de irse, se prueba la reparacion y el area de trabajo queda limpia, tal como lo describen las resenas.
texto.en: Before leaving, the fix gets tested and the work area is left clean, just like customers describe in their reviews.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza despues de una llamada rapida. Cuentanos que pasa y recibe una respuesta real, sin adivinar.
nota.en: Every job is quoted after a quick call. Tell us what's going on and get a real answer, no guesswork.

texto.es: Valvulas de cierre, valvulas reguladoras de presion y fugas en lineas de suministro, arregladas para que la presion y la plomeria queden donde deben.
texto.en: Shut-off valves, pressure-reducing valves and supply line leaks, fixed so the pressure and the plumbing stay where they should.

texto.es: Instalacion, reparacion y trabajo de tanque de expansion para calentadores de agua tradicionales, cotizado tras revisar tu instalacion.
texto.en: Installation, repair and expansion tank work for traditional water heaters, quoted after a quick look at your setup.

texto.es: Drenajes lentos o tapados, destapados desde la causa, desde lavabos de bano hasta lineas de cocina.
texto.en: Slow or clogged drains cleared at the source, from bathroom sinks to kitchen lines.

texto.es: Grifos, tocadores, lavamanos y estufas instalados de forma limpia para remodelaciones de cocina y bano.
texto.en: Faucets, vanities, sinks and cooktops installed clean for kitchen and bathroom remodels.

pie.es: No sabes cual es el problema? Llama y describelo: Josh te dira que es probable que sea antes de que alguien vaya.
pie.en: Not sure what the problem is? Call and describe it, Josh will tell you what it likely is before anyone comes out.

items.quote: A staple of our business is remodeling kitchens & bathrooms. I want to make sure the plumbing is done right, looks good and the client is happy with the customer experience and how clean it looks when complete. Josh with Joshua Tree checks ALL the boxes! He is the very best!

He took care of our rental property in Brandon and recently installed a water softener in our new home in Riverview. Friendly, professional, knowledgeable. Thank you - we will never use any other company!

Joshua Tree Plumbing did a great job fixing a bad shut off valve and added a new brass ball valve and pressure reducing valve to get my 90psi pressure down to a safer pressure coming in my house. Great communication and service.
